items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I wasn't bothering. Barney went up there. He went up there. He was poor, but Barney wasn't in it with poor down here.

ctx.x: I'll tell you that now. I wasn't bothering. Barney went up there. He went up there. He was poor, but Barney wasn't in it with poor down here. He wasn't the one that he was. But he went up there. He got made up there. He was poor.
He was poor. Did he play clarinet down here mostly or mostly saxophone? Saxophone. Yeah.
